text: まつ　ことも　また！

structure.jp: まつ　ことも　また！

patterns.name: 〜こと (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: こと after a plain verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. まつ　こと = 'waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜もまた
patterns.explanation: も followed by また is a slightly formal 'this too, likewise'. まつ　ことも　また = 'waiting, too, is likewise'.
